_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: JupyterLab
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: JupyterLab runs Python notebooks in the browser, with a file browser, terminals and a text editor. Notebooks live in the notebooks folder; sign in with the password, or the link the console shows.
startup: h=$( (python3 --version; cat .raptor-jupyterlab.txt; echo "${PY_PACKAGES}") | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing JupyterLab"; rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check -q -r .raptor-jupyterlab.txt ${PY_PACKAGES} && echo "$h" > .venv/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; if [ -n "${JUPYTER_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then set -- --IdentityProvider.token= --PasswordIdentityProvider.hashed_password="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import os; from jupyter_server.auth import passwd; print(passwd(os.environ["JUPYTER_PASSWORD"]))')" || exit 1; fi; [ "${UPDATE_CHECK}" = 1 ] || set -- "$@" --LabApp.news_url=None --LabApp.check_for_updates_class=jupyterlab.NeverCheckForUpdate; mkdir -p notebooks; exec .venv/bin/jupyter lab --no-browser --ip=0.0.0.0 --port={{SERVER_PORT}} --ServerApp.port_retries=0 --ServerApp.root_dir=/home/container/notebooks "$@"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# JupyterLab: checks the chosen version on PyPI and writes it to
# .raptor-jupyterlab.txt; the server installs it (in .venv, for the Python
# version it runs) when it next starts. Notebooks and settings are never
# touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" https://pypi.org/pypi/jupyterlab/json) ||
    fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(jq -r .info.version <<<"$meta")
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] && want="$latest"
jq -e --arg v "$want" '.releases[$v] | length > 0 and all(.yanked | not)' <<<"$meta" >/dev/null ||
    fail "JupyterLab has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."

echo "jupyterlab==$want" > .raptor-jupyterlab.txt.new
mv -f .raptor-jupyterlab.txt.new .raptor-jupyterlab.txt
mkdir -p notebooks
echo "Installed JupyterLab $want; it's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The JupyterLab version to install, such as 4.6.6, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password to sign in with. Leave it empty to use a random token instead, shown in the console's link at every start.

variables.name: Extra packages
variables.description: More Python packages for your notebooks, separated by spaces, such as numpy pandas matplotlib. They're installed at the next start.

variables.name: Update check
variables.description: Set it to 1 to let JupyterLab check for new versions and show Jupyter news.
